title: Wik-Mungkan people - Wikipedia
text: The Wik-Mungkan people are an Aboriginal Australian group of peoples who traditionally ranged over an extensive area of the western Cape York Peninsula in northern Queensland and speak the Wik Mungkan language.

title: Wik Mungkan language - Wikipedia
text: Wik-Mungkan, or Wik-Mungknh, is a Paman language spoken on the northern part of Cape York Peninsula of Queensland, Australia, by around 1,000 Wik-Mungkan people, and related peoples including the Wikalkan, Wik-Ngathana, Wikngenchera language groups. [3]

title: Wik-Mungkan people — Grokipedia
text: The Wik-Mungkan language maintains relative vitality compared to many other Australian Indigenous languages, with approximately 952 speakers recorded in the 2021 Australian census, primarily concentrated in the Aurukun community where it serves as a strong first language for children and youth.
